main_theorem.statement: for all S (the external <&Vec<T> as IntoIterator>::into_iter as a parameter) with premise hS (S Global w = ok the slice iterator over w from index 0), all inst p a proof public hash with p.variant = S2, a.next = 10, length a.weights = 64: fresh verifier.checkpoint S inst p a proof public hash = (WAdm_fields (toGatePrepared p) a.rhs a.power >>= fun f => WAdm_checkpoint inst f a.weights proof public hash)
main_theorem.not_claimed: all-input equality (the gate hard-codes S2, 10 and 64 weights); equality for other variants; the WideExact::to_le_bytes body; array and slice iterator library models
